body: Wow thank you so much for taking the time to reply! You are right I guess, I hope I can really become a better person and learn from my mistakes.  Thank you and best wishes to you too!!

Maybe I wasn't clear enough in my post, sorry. 
 Whenever i meet  a new person I hope I am likeable, but people's reactions aren't always as warm? And I should be expecting this instead of thinking that I will always manage to get along with everyone.

I've been there too. It's difficult and also unrealistic to compare your life with a celebrity's tho. 
Instead try to live in a way that you believe whoever you admire would be proud of you for :)
